title: 少年棋手与变色龙的超级舌头

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! Today, two stars: a boy who beat a chess legend at ten, and a chameleon with a tongue longer than its body. Ready? Let's play!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！今天有两位明星：一位是十岁就打败国际象棋传奇的男孩，另一位是舌头比身体还长的变色龙。准备好了吗？开始吧！

blocks.en: In Argentina, there is a boy named Faustino Oro, called the "Messi of chess." He did not learn it at school. He started playing online games at home at seven, while everyone stayed home. His father made an account for him, and soon he played everywhere — after breakfast and before bed. The bond between father and son grew with every game they watched together.
blocks.title: 少年棋手
blocks.cn: 在阿根廷，有个男孩叫福斯蒂诺·奥罗，大家叫他“国际象棋界的梅西”。他不是在学校学会下棋的。七岁那年，大家都待在家里的时候，他开始在家里玩网络国际象棋。爸爸给他注册了一个账号，很快他走到哪儿下到哪儿——早饭后下，睡前也下。父子之间的纽带，随着一起看过的每一盘棋越系越紧。

blocks.en: Every weekday, homework first, then chess. He learned fast — faster than a balloon rising. He studies the board like an accountant: every piece counts. In the course of a year, he played hundreds of games online. Win by win, he accumulated points and climbed higher. Meanwhile, older players noticed him. The statistics tell the story: he became the youngest player ever to pass 2300 points, and at only ten, he became the youngest International Master ever. The chess federation approved his title, and fans everywhere knew his name.
blocks.title: 少年棋手
blocks.cn: 每个工作日，先做完作业，再下棋。他学得很快——比升空的气球还快。他像会计研究数字一样研究棋盘：每一颗棋子都重要。一年里，他在网上就下了几百盘棋。一盘一盘赢下来，他积攒了积分，越爬越高。同时，年纪更大的棋手们开始注意到他。数据说明了一切：他成了有史以来最年轻的 2300 分棋手，而仅仅十岁时，他就成了有史以来最年轻的国际大师。国际象棋联合会批准了他的头衔，全世界的棋迷都知道了他的名字。

blocks.en: But his most famous game was on a computer screen. In a fast online game, ten-year-old Faustino beat Magnus Carlsen, a former world champion! His facial expression stayed calm. His coach says: a calm mind wins more games than fast hands. When he lost, he did not mourn for long — he looked at the board and asked, "What can I learn?" The road was not always easy, but game after game, he kept going. And now, at twelve, he is a Grandmaster. What a star!
blocks.title: 少年棋手
blocks.cn: 但他最出名的一盘棋是在电脑屏幕上下出来的。在一场快棋网络对局里，十岁的福斯蒂诺打败了前世界冠军芒努斯·卡尔森！他的面部表情始终平静。他的教练说：冷静的头脑比快手赢得更多棋局。输棋的时候，他不会难过太久——他看看棋盘，问自己：“我能学到什么？”这条路并不总是一帆风顺，但一盘接一盘，他坚持了下来。而现在，十二岁的他已经是一位特级大师了。真是一颗明星！

blocks.en: Now climb into the trees and meet the chameleon, the quiet king of hide-and-seek. A chameleon changes color and moves its eyes in two directions at once. But its greatest trick is its tongue. A big chameleon's tongue can be twice its body length, and a tiny one's two and a half times! Imagine your tongue reaching across the whole classroom!
blocks.title: 变色龙的超级舌头
blocks.cn: 现在爬到树上，认识变色龙——这位安静的捉迷藏之王。变色龙会变色，两只眼睛还能同时朝两个方向转。但它最厉害的本领是舌头。大变色龙的舌头可以达到体长的两倍，小变色龙的甚至能达到两倍半！想象一下，你的舌头能伸到整间教室那么远！

blocks.en: How does it work? The tongue sits folded like an accordion over a small bone. When it sees a cricket, muscles pull back slowly, like drawing a bow. Then — snap! The tongue shoots out faster than lightning, in less than a tenth of a second. Stretchy tissues work like a spring, storing power and letting go all at once. The tip is covered with sticky mucus, thicker than honey, so the cricket sticks fast. It can even catch a bug as heavy as one-third of its own weight!
blocks.title: 变色龙的超级舌头
blocks.cn: 这是怎么做到的呢？舌头折叠起来，像手风琴一样搭在一块小骨头上。看到蟋蟀时，肌肉慢慢向后拉，就像拉开一张弓。然后——啪！舌头以比闪电还快的速度弹射出去，不到十分之一秒。有弹性的组织像弹簧一样工作，把力量储存起来，再一下子释放出去。舌尖上覆盖着黏黏的黏液，比蜂蜜还稠，所以蟋蟀一碰就被牢牢粘住。它甚至能抓住相当于自身体重三分之一的虫子！

blocks.en: Then the tongue pulls the meal back — dinner is served, without moving a step. Scientists love this trick: it works in hot deserts and cold mountains alike. So remember: slow feet, quick tongue — the chameleon's secret!
blocks.title: 变色龙的超级舌头
blocks.cn: 然后舌头把猎物拉回来——不用挪动一步，晚餐就上桌了。科学家们很喜欢这个本领：它在炎热的沙漠和寒冷的高山上都同样管用。所以记住：慢脚步，快舌头——这就是变色龙的秘密！

blocks.en: Today's idiom: 'zip your lips.' When you zip your lips, you keep a secret and say nothing at all! Here's an example: 'Mom made bacon sandwiches for the picnic, and she told us to zip our lips, or everyone would want one!' Zip your lips, and the secret will not leak out. When do you need to zip your lips?
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是“zip your lips”（拉上嘴唇的拉链）。当你 zip your lips 时，你就是保守一个秘密，什么都不说！举个例子：“妈妈为野餐做了培根三明治，她让我们拉上嘴唇的拉链，不然人人都想要一个！”拉上嘴唇的拉链，秘密就不会泄露出去。你什么时候需要拉上嘴唇的拉链呢？

blocks.en: Let's think: a chess star, and a chameleon with a super tongue. First: Faustino studies every lost game — what do you do when you lose a game? Second: if your tongue were twice as long as your body, what would you use it for? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 我们来想想：一位国际象棋明星，和一只超级舌头的变色龙。第一：福斯蒂诺会研究每一盘输掉的棋——你输棋的时候会怎么做？第二：如果你的舌头有身体的两倍长，你会用它来做什么？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That's all for today, young explorers. Keep your mind sharp, and when it is time for a secret, zip your lips! See you tomorrow!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里啦，小小探险家们。保持头脑敏锐，当需要保守秘密的时候，拉上嘴唇的拉链！明天见！

quiz.title: B. 单项选择（Single Choice）
questions:
How did Faustino Oro first learn chess?
A. At school with his teacher
B. By playing online games at home
C. From a book about Messi
D. At a chess club in Madrid

What happened when ten-year-old Faustino played Magnus Carlsen in a fast online game?
A. He lost very quickly
B. The game was a draw
C. He beat the former world champion

How does a chameleon catch a cricket?
A. It runs after the cricket
B. It shoots out its long, sticky tongue

D. It waits for the cricket to fall asleep

What does "zip your lips" mean?
A. To close a bag
B. To sing very loudly
C. To keep a secret and say nothing

children.text: When it sees a cricket, muscles pull back slowly, like drawing a bow.
when 引导的时间状语从句
：when（当……的时候）+ 一个完整的小句子，放在主句前面，告诉你主句的动作发生在什么时候——看到蟋蟀的那一刻，肌肉才开始向后拉。英语里 when 从句可以放句首（后面加逗号），也可以放句尾。
like + 动名词短语作比较
：like（像……一样）+ drawing（动名词），把肌肉向后拉的动作比作拉开一张弓，让你一下子就能想象出那个慢动作。like 后面跟动名词，表示“像做某事一样”。
：pull（拉）+ back（向后），两个词合起来才是一个完整的意思——向后拉。英语里很多动词都要和小品词搭伙，才表示得出方向和结果。
时间（看到蟋蟀时）→ 动作（肌肉向后拉）→ 画面（像拉弓一样慢）
。一句话里藏着时间状语从句、like 比较和短语动词三个机关。
"started playing online games at home at seven."
"Ten-year-old Faustino beat Magnus Carlsen, a former world champion!"
"The tongue shoots out faster than lightning."
"When you zip your lips, you keep a secret and say nothing at all!"
D. Your own translations — there is no key for this part. Read your Chinese aloud and check that it sounds natural.
